task:
A gross settlement of 1977 credits is reduced by 22%. The reduced figure includes a 38% fee measured on its fee-free base; remove that included fee by division. Then add 4% of the ORIGINAL gross settlement. What is the exact result? Do not round. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 9 credits, then discount the whole amount by 19%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 13% surcharge, then subtract 27 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 22 credits, then discount the whole amount by 13%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 6% surcharge, then subtract 15 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 13 credits, then discount the whole amount by 4%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 6% surcharge, then subtract 14 credits.
Adjustment 7: add 22 credits, then discount the whole amount by 5%.
Adjustment 8: apply a 8% surcharge, then subtract 19 credits.
Adjustment 9: add 10 credits, then discount the whole amount by 16%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 11% surcharge, then subtract 8 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 24 credits, then discount the whole amount by 17%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 8% surcharge, then subtract 3 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 17 credits, then discount the whole amount by 8%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 14% surcharge, then subtract 12 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 15 credits, then discount the whole amount by 16%.
Adjustment 16: apply a 11% surcharge, then subtract 25 credits.
Adjustment 17: add 10 credits, then discount the whole amount by 11%.
Adjustment 18: apply a 18% surcharge, then subtract 12 credits.
Adjustment 19: add 21 credits, then discount the whole amount by 3%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
